ShortDescription.Value: Better Transit Boarding. Late passengers stop holding up vehicles, and cims can RUN earlier to catch Buses, Trams, Trains, and Subways.

Publish.LongDescription:
#### Late Passengers stop holding up transit
- Like Japanese oshiya👨‍✈️pushers but in a mod 😊
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
The game can keep a vehicle stuck wait for passengers long past departure time — even if the cim is far away!
Vanilla only releases a stuck vehicle after ~10 minutes. └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
**Better Boarding helps before that by reducing Late Passengers to keep transit moving which in turn helps vanilla un-bunch vehicles.**
This mod mostly targets citizen behavior as the bus schedule doesn't matter if a cim 4 blocks away can stop the bus from leaving.
### Skip Late Passengers
- ✅ When **Skip Late** is enabled, late citizens who are still **not ready** even after **departure time** can miss that vehicle instead of making everyone wait. - The cim is not deleted and the game can naturally reassign them. - Groups/families traveling together; helps the vehicle leave instead of waiting up to 10 minutes for one member separated or not at the station.
### Cims Run Sooner 🏃‍➡️🏃‍♀️‍➡️🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🚍
- ✅ When **Cims Run Sooner** is ON, the assigned but late passengers can start running a little sooner. - Vanilla starts cims running at departure time, which can be too late if they are not already at the stop/station. - In real life, people start running from a block away, not just at the stop. - Helps with long train stations where cims are in a hang around area far from the train doors. - Helps reduce how many cims miss their ride and need to be reassigned; does not change schedules, or departure time - allows vanilla to safely finish transactions.
### Boarding/Loading - ✅ Adjust boarding/loading times, helps with dwell time. - ✅ Lets late cims miss a vehicle (if it's after departure time) so others are not held up. - ✅ Late cims can also start running sooner so they have a chance to catch their ride (bus + tram + train + subway). - Helps reduce transit delays, traffic backups, and vehicle bunching. Even more useful in big cities with lots of public transit.
### Notes - **Compatibility:** should not use Better Boarding and All-Aboard at the same time - pick one. - Some players report no issues with Smart Transportation with Better Boarding. - Mod is intended to be a lighter, safer alternative than replacing the game's whole transport system files approach. - This mod works nicely with [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows) to solve many transit issues. - Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony patches; lightweight design for low overhead. - Note: vanilla has un-bunching formulas and may hold back a vehicle a little longer to space them out - this is normal if it's not excessive 10 minutes.
### Support and feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. No donations requested. - Feedback on GitHub and Discord links (icons on the right). PRs welcome.
### Credits and Thanks
- River-Mochi - mod author - Inspiration and thanks to bcallender's All Aboard mod and Wayze's InstantBoarding. - yenyang (Anarchy) - code review/feedback and testing. - 🎀 foxxy ✿, MayorCheeks, Empiiey, Neco1996, Gagaxm - testing. - elGendo87 - Spanish editor, thumbnail straightener, testing.
### 15+ Languages
Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, Cześć, Oi, Olá, สวัสดี, Merhaba, Привіт, Xin chào, 你好, 哈囉
### How does it work?
Better Boarding leaves vanilla transport, departure scheduling, and un-bunching in control as they can work well with a little help. It mainly steps in when late passengers would keep boarding open too long and cause unnecessary delays. This is more a Citizen Behavior change.
**Solo late passengers**
- If they are still too late, they can miss that vehicle; then we let vanilla naturally reroute them, often on the next bus.
**Late groups/families**
- If the leader is still outside, the whole group can miss the vehicle together (vanilla methods). - If the leader is already aboard, Better Boarding nudges the game's normal system to finish boarding a child/pet so the family stays together and the vehicle can leave.
**Run Sooner**
- Vanilla already has cims start running at stops but not until departure time, which is often too late, especially on long platforms. - We allow assigned passengers to begin running 512 frames earlier (a few seconds). - Does not change vehicle schedule or departure times.
### Bonus Status report
After the city runs a bit, check Options for current waits, worst stops, late skipped passengers, and Run Sooner counts.
- If a stop has a huge wait, check it for traffic, bad placement, needs more vehicles, or just swap out a bugged bus stop. - [Stats to Log] makes a detailed one-time log entry with current stop names, Entity IDs, hints, and more. - It only runs when clicked; it is not a continuous per-frame system, so there is no ongoing performance cost.
**What does lightweight mean?**
Better Boarding does not use Harmony patches or replace entire game transport systems. It works alongside and improves the game's normal systems. It is designed to have a low performance impact, even in large cities.
- If you got this far, congrats, say hi, there is a senryu poem I wrote just for you in images. Click Like 👍 button, it's hard, I know, and so tiny.
